targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', ts) * 1000 AS time, value AS "Load" FROM readings WHERE device_id='meter-01' AND point_id='load_kw' AND quality='good' AND ts >= datetime($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND ts <= datetime($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY ts
